title: Analysis: Federal Reserve may be pulled into Bessent’s effort to support Japan’s yen
summary_full: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wants to defend the yen without selling Treasurys into a sensitive U.S. bond market. The Federal Reserve could help.
